title: Microsoft Purview: Adaptive Protection retains content deleted by high-risk users (GCC, GCC High and DoD)
summary: The briefing accurately separates the planned government-cloud release from the documented commercial-cloud preview. The roadmap details, retention behaviour, setup distinctions, licensing context and governance controls are supported; government-specific defaults and requirements remain explicitly unconfirmed.

claims.claim: This roadmap change belongs to Microsoft Purview.
claims.quote: "products": ["Microsoft Purview"]

claims.claim: The integration will automatically apply retention labels to preserve deleted emails and files based on insider risk level.
claims.quote: The integration with Data Lifecycle Management will automatically apply retention labels to preserve deleted emails and files based on a user’s insider risk level.

claims.claim: Adaptive Protection moves users in and out of policies as their insider risk levels change.
claims.quote: integrating dynamic insider risk levels, determined by data related activities, with various policy engines to automatically moving users in and out of policies as their risk levels change over time

claims.where: summary; What's changing; Risk assessment; Scope; rationale: impact
claims.claim: The documented retention integration targets users assigned the Elevated insider risk level.
claims.quote: For data lifecycle management, the data lifecycle management policy monitors users that assign an Elevated risk level by Insider Risk Management Adaptive Protection.

claims.claim: The automatic retention label applies to previously unlabelled content deleted by those users.
claims.quote: When you enable Adaptive Protection for your tenant, retention labels are automatically applied to unlabeled content if it's deleted by users who have been identified as an elevated risk.

claims.claim: The documented deleted-content locations are SharePoint, OneDrive and Exchange.
claims.quote: If these users delete content from SharePoint, OneDrive, or Exchange, a retention label is automatically applied to that content to retain it for 120 days.

claims.claim: The retention policy is automatically created and applies retention automatically.
claims.quote: The data lifecycle management policy, which is automatically created, applies protection actions for any user assigned to the Elevated risk level.

claims.quote: In preview, you can use this solution with Insider Risk Management so that retention labels are automatically applied with Adaptive Protection.

claims.claim: There is a single retention label and auto-labeling retention policy for the tenant.
claims.quote: The single retention label and auto-labeling retention policy for your tenant aren't visible in the Microsoft Purview portal.

claims.quote: Unlike other labeling scenarios, users don't see the retention label

claims.claim: The quick-setup table says the retention policy is automatically created and applied when Adaptive Protection is first turned on.
claims.quote: If you haven't already turned on Adaptive Protection, the policy is automatically created and applied when you turn on Adaptive Protection.

claims.quote: If you have already turned on Adaptive Protection, you need to explicitly opt in to the data lifecycle management policy that's created automatically.

claims.claim: The custom-setup note requires an explicit opt-in to apply the data lifecycle management policy.
claims.quote: If you turn on Adaptive Protection for your organization, you need to explicitly opt in to apply the data lifecycle management policy.

claims.claim: Tenants that enabled and configured Adaptive Protection before the integration released need to opt in.
claims.quote: If you enabled and configured Adaptive Protection before this integration with data lifecycle management released, you'll need to opt-in to create this auto-labeling policy.

claims.claim: The data lifecycle management setting cannot be turned on unless Adaptive Protection is turned on for the tenant.

claims.claim: Adjusting insider risk level conditions changes which users qualify for Elevated and therefore retention.
claims.quote: Increase or decrease the severity of the activity required to assign an insider risk level. For example, reduce the activity or alert severity if you're seeing too few users with insider risk levels.

claims.claim: Turning off Adaptive protection in Data Lifecycle Management deletes its policy.

claims.quote: Any retention labels that were applied as a result of Adaptive Protection are removed so that the items can then become eligible for permanent deletion.

claims.claim: Turning off Adaptive Protection stops assigning insider risk levels and sharing them with data lifecycle management.
claims.quote: If you turn off Adaptive Protection after it's been on and active, the system stops assigning insider risk levels to users and stops sharing them with data loss prevention, data lifecycle management, and Conditional Access.

claims.claim: Turning off Adaptive Protection itself does not automatically delete the data lifecycle management policy.
claims.quote: The Insider Risk Management, data loss prevention, data lifecycle management, and Conditional Access policies aren't automatically deleted.
